name: Pondside
description: The ruined village, whose villagers fled south toward Haymeadow.

description_citations.work: Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found
description_citations.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Nerys scolds Helga for neglecting her chores and fishing for visions at the pond.
timeline.quote: And get your head out of yon scrying pool,

citation.work: Bloomburrow | Episode 1: Calamity Comes to Valley
citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 1: Calamity Comes to Valley" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Helga sees that her drawing resembles a Calamity Beast and resolves to show it to Iver.
timeline.quote: If she were having a true seeing of a Calamity Beast, her village could be in grave danger.

citation.work: Bloomburrow | Episode 1: Calamity Comes to Valley
citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 1: Calamity Comes to Valley" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Maha, the Night Owl, appears over Pondside as the village bell clangs.

citation.work: Bloomburrow | Episode 1: Calamity Comes to Valley
citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 1: Calamity Comes to Valley" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: The Night Owl swoops over Pondside, destroying houses and starting fires while villagers flee.

citation.work: Bloomburrow | Episode 1: Calamity Comes to Valley
citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 1: Calamity Comes to Valley" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: The party reaches the ruins of Pondside and Hugs and Mabel read tracks showing the villagers went south toward Haymeadow.
timeline.quote: Haymeadow, likely. It's closer than Goodhill.

citation.work: Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found
citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Two squirrelfolk necromancers are found looting the wreckage and mention Cruelclaw and the owl's earlier attack.
timeline.quote: Helga's skin crawled. The last one? So, her dream-vision was true?

citation.work: Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found
citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: The necromancers raise skeletons and the party fights them.
timeline.quote: dozens of gleaming eyes surrounded the Goodhill delegation.

citation.work: Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found
citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Helga makes water steps so Mabel can reach the birds, but loses control of the spell; Mabel still kills the skeleton.
timeline.quote: With a sound like a bubble popping, the stairs fell to splatter the soil.

citation.work: Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found
citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: The necromancers flee toward the Long River, and the party decides to follow them to Three Tree City.
timeline.quote: "We follow the squirrelfolk," she said. "To Three Tree."

citation.work: Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found
citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Helga packs keepsakes from her grandparents' damaged home before leaving.
timeline.quote: Why did she take her grandfather's wand, set his wide-brimmed hat on her own head?

citation.work: Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found
citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2024.

relations.note: The Calamity Beast attacks and destroys Pondside.
relations.quote: demolishing the mousefolk house with its half-finished roof

citation.work: Bloomburrow | Episode 1: Calamity Comes to Valley
